# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.

completion:
Compile a list of products that failed to meet their advertised specifications.
3. For each product:
    a. Record the following details about the product:
        i. Product name
        ii. Brand or Manufacturer.
        iii. Model number.
        iv. Name of the retailer from which the product was purchased
        v. Price paid for the product
        vi. Date of purchase
    b. Document the specific test results that failed:
        i. State the advertised specification (e.g., "100 hours of battery life").
        ii. State the actual tested performance (e.g., "70 hours of battery life").
        iii. Name the specific test conducted to verify the performance.
        c. Calculate the percentage difference between the advertised and actual performance.
        d. Include a qualitative assessment of the product's overall performance in relation to its advertised claims.
